title: 3D Gaussian Splatting Compression with Object Scalability

sections.label: Overview
sections.summary: RecastGS reorganizes unordered 3DGS into a region-aware layered hierarchy, and LayeredCGS compresses it progressively.

sections.label: Problem
sections.summary: Uniform 3DGS compression makes preview, truncation, and object-level quality allocation difficult.

sections.label: RecastGS
sections.summary: Overcomplete layer search, progressive distillation, and prompt-driven extraction build a recomposable representation.

sections.label: LayeredCGS
sections.summary: Layer-wise context conditions later layers on previously decoded layers for better feed-forward compression.

sections.label: Results
sections.summary: RecastGS and LayeredCGS reduce BD-BR over GoDe and FCGS, respectively.

sections.label: ROI Control
sections.summary: Foreground and background subsets can be recomposed at different target quality levels.

sections.label: Poster
sections.summary: The ECCV 2026 poster summarizes the method, quantitative results, progressive visualization, and ablations.
